entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Where runtime Helix minutes go, and why WebAssembly is a large share #138441
  • [API Proposal]: Obsolete Path.GetInvalidPathChars #138439
  • Regex NonBacktracking: after a match longer than 41,658 chars, the last match swallows one extra character #138432
  • Performance regression combining `double.ToString` and `Math.Log10` on .NET 11 #138428
  • Build fails on .NET 11 when [LoggerMessage] is used in non-class types #138426
  • [mono] Debugger doesn't send ASSEMBLY_LOAD events for assemblies loaded before VM_START (breakpoints not hit with AOT + dedup) #138422
  • Console formatters write a custom TimestampFormat in the current culture, so the date follows a non-Gregorian calendar #138420
  • HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 don't drop invalid trailing headers #138419
    12.0.0
  • JsonConsoleFormatter throws on NaN and infinite double and float values, failing the log call #138418
  • FileStatus.IsModeReadOnlyCore compares group with user where its comment says other: an extra getgroups per entry, and a wrong ReadOnly for some modes #138417
  • RegexOptions.NonBacktracking misses a match for .*(?:a|a.*a) #138416
  • Consider using TypeMap for System.Text.Json converters #138415
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Crossgen2 comparison reports a CoreLib image hash mismatch #138414
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: JIT reports extra tree flags while optimizing SchemaCollectionCompiler #138413

    12.0.0
  • [mono] AOT profiler: prof_shutdown() closes the output FILE twice #138403
  • [mono][aot] lookup_external_icall_symbol_name_aot() looks up and inserts in a global hash table from worker threads without locking #138401
  • Test failure: System.Net.Security.Tests.CertificateValidationRemoteServer.ConnectWithRevocation_WithCallback #138400
  • [mono][aot] collect_dedup_method() mutates process-global dedup tables from worker threads without locking #138399
  • [mono] Losing a reference-load race closes an assembly the loader never addref'd #138398
  • System.Speech, System.CodeDom and two MEF packages ship IsAotCompatible=True despite IsTrimmable=false, so IL3058 misses them #138396
  • Linux x64: SIGSEGV when a signal arrives while the SIGSEGV handler is still on the 16 KB alternate stack (AVX-512 signal frames don't fit) #138394
  • Assert failure: GetSP(static_cast<RedirectedThreadFrame*>(pFrame)->GetContext()) == GetSP(pContextRecord) #138392
  • JIT: Remove trivial 32->64bit zero-extensions on x64 #138390

Closed

  • Runtime-created threads don't follow cgroup cpuset changes on Linux 6.2+ #136015
  • [Android] SslStream on Android 9 (API 28) fails with ArgumentException "SSL_NULL_WITH_NULL_NULL" since .NET 11 Preview 4 — is this expected? #136456
    12.0.0
  • [.NET 11 regression] Uri.IsWellFormedUriString fails on relative URI with escaped Unicode symbols #138381
  • Make HttpKnownHeaderNames public #138393
